source: Representative shard and loop action shapes copied from the active MVP-safe module outputs in app.js.

actions.title: Add current LR for loop guardrails
actions.subtitle: Minimum loop-warning input missing
whyNow: Current LR is the minimum grounded input needed for loop-reset guardrails in this build.
Grounded loop guidance depends on pacing examples tied to specific LR transitions.
assumptions: This module is warning-oriented only and does not simulate best reset timing.
warnings: Without current LR, the app cannot show the anti-bricking pacing notes captured in the research bundle.
actions.notes: Loop guardrails remain descriptive and source-linked.

actions.title: Loop requirement pacing warning
actions.subtitle: Current LR 6
whyNow: Guide examples warn that pushing LR too quickly can raise loop requirements faster than the account can clear them.
Grounded examples show LR 5 -> 6 requiring 7 loops and LR 6 -> 7 requiring 8 loops.
assumptions: This is a caution zone, not a target recommendation.
The app does not estimate whether your account can safely push the next LR.
warnings: Use buffer / instant loop checks before pushing LR higher.
High LR progression can become 'playing with fire' in guide-side progression notes.
actions.notes: Guardrail based on grounded guide examples, not simulated reset math.

actions.title: Next shard unlock to watch
actions.subtitle: All imported unlock requirements are covered
whyNow: Tracked total shard milestone levels already cover all imported unlock requirements.
Add total shard milestone levels in Player Data to track unlock pacing more precisely.
Current shards and shard income remain optional manual inputs.
assumptions: Unlock sequencing is descriptive only and does not imply best spend order.
Shard optimization math remains disabled while per-level shard costs are unknown.
warnings: No shard milestone ranking, ROI, ETA, or cost simulation is active in this workflow.
Shard milestone sources include unresolved discrepancies that keep this workflow descriptive.
Unlocked does not mean affordable; shard cost data is still unavailable.
actions.notes: This card watches descriptive unlock gates only.

actions.title: Next shard threshold to watch
actions.subtitle: Alpha Milestone
whyNow: Focus milestone rarity: Common. Threshold schedule: 1 | 25 | 50.
Next bonus threshold is level 25 from tracked level 20.
assumptions: Boosts Cells gained, MK5 output, and Shards gained at milestone level thresholds.
Besides thresholds, incremental level increases the effect of each bonus (multiplicatively).
warnings: Name/bonus mismatch versus older Game-Vault snapshot (Aqua vs Alpha; MK5 Output vs Mod Points at level 25).
Threshold wording stays descriptive because milestone sources conflict across accessible snapshots.
You need 5 more levels on the selected milestone to reach this threshold.
actions.notes: Threshold guidance is milestone-specific and descriptive only.

actions.title: Shard cost bump watch
actions.subtitle: Alpha Milestone
whyNow: Shard Milestones experience a cost bump every 100 levels (Large cost bump at level 100 and 400 and small cost bump at level 200 and 300, Larger Bumps every 100 afterwards).
From tracked level 20, the next noted cost bump is level 100 (large).
assumptions: The dataset provides breakpoint notes, not numeric shard costs.
Observed examples are shown separately and do not become planner truth.
warnings: Cost bumps are warning zones only; the app does not estimate shard affordability.
Cost wording stays generic until a single authoritative milestone list and cost table exist.
No per-level shard costs provided; only global cost-bump statements exist.
actions.notes: Use this to avoid false precision near known cost-bump levels.

actions.title: Buffer check before pushing LR
actions.subtitle: Current LR 7
whyNow: Higher LR examples stay risky without a buffer for failed clears or longer reset pacing.
warnings: Treat this as a caution prompt only until stronger loop owner data is grounded.
actions.notes: Representative partial-context warning with no explicit assumption text yet.
